title: Divertente e utile
body: Ho cominciato da poco ma per adesso lo trovo molto buono. Sfrutta il sistema della ricompensa utilizzando la cura dell’uccellino così sprona a portare a termine i compiti. Questi poi sono molto liberi, si può scegliere di seguire i suggerimenti o inserirli manualmente. Suggerirei di aggiungere maggiori opzioni sullo sviluppo del proprio finch, oltre alla personalizzazione dell’abbigliamento e dell’arredamento, perché una sola avventura al giorno e un po’ monotona. Per il resto la app sembra seria, funziona benissimo anche senza abbonamento, non è chiaro quanto costi poiché dopo due giorni viene data una prova gratuita di 3 giorni, quindi a me non sono ancora comparse le offerte.

title: I would give more stars if I could
body:
This app is amazing. It has helped me so much from organising my day to day activities to calm me and reflect when struggling with anxiety attacks. You can set goals, do breathing exercises, reflect on your day and so much more, while watching your pet go on adventures and see the world from another perspective.
If you want to start taking care for your mental (and physical) health, while taking care of a cute pet, you should definitely download Finch.

title: Cute and comforting
body:
I downloaded this game after seeing a post on FB talking about it. I was charmed by the cute birds, so I thought “why not?”
This game really helps clear out your thoughts and contains what are called “first aid” for when you feel too much anxious or stressed to function. It really helped me calm down a few times. Meanwhile you take care of your bird and watch it grow and discover the world, as it is seen by a child. You can customise them, choose clothes for them and name them. I definitely recommend it!
